title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM
title_zh: Integrated Marketing Attribution：一种以 MMM 为锚点的隐私安全细粒度贝叶斯营销归因框架
abstract_en: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.
abstract_zh: 零售营销度量越来越需要在不依赖用户级追踪的前提下获得 campaign 级别的细粒度洞察。现有两类主流方法 Marketing Mix Modeling（MMM）与 Multi-Touch Attribution（MTA）往往各有局限：MMM 具备隐私安全性，且适合 channel 级规划，但粒度过粗，难以支持 campaign 优化；MTA 能提供更细粒度归因，但在隐私限制增强的环境下可靠性下降。本文提出 Integrated Marketing Attribution（IMA），一个统一框架，将 MMM 与 channel-specific Bayesian attribution models 结合，从聚合数据中估计 campaign 级效果。通过使用 MMM-informed priors，IMA 在保持与 MMM 一致性的同时，实现隐私安全的细粒度营销归因。
key_points_zh: 提出 Integrated Marketing Attribution（IMA），将 MMM 的宏观稳健性与 Bayesian attribution 的细粒度能力结合。
IMA 不依赖用户级追踪，而是基于 aggregated data 估计 campaign-level effects，更适应隐私受限环境。
通过 MMM-informed priors 约束 channel-specific Bayesian attribution models，使 campaign 归因结果与 MMM 的 channel 级估计保持一致。
相比传统 MMM，IMA 能支持更细粒度的 campaign 优化；相比 MTA，IMA 更具 privacy-safe 特性和鲁棒性。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper addresses retail marketing measurement, but it is only weakly connected to e-commerce agents, search, recommendation, or shopping assistance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文关注零售营销归因测量，但与电商智能体、搜索、推荐或购物辅助的关联较弱。
